source_method: Read source GeoTIFF inside WGS84 bbox, warp population counts with rasterio Resampling.sum into EPSG:3826 500m grid. Retain source population within crop.
note: Source TIFF is a 10-degree EU/JRC GHS-POP tile; output is a geographic rectangular Taiwan-region crop, NOT a Taiwan administrative boundary clip. Coverage excludes most Penghu, Kinmen and Matsu; unlisted cells have zero estimated population, NOT necessarily water. GHS-POP estimates people per source pixel, not population density. Rows/cols start at zero; projected grid is EPSG:3826, center lat/lon are EPSG:4326.

fields.row: zero-based grid row, north to south
fields.col: zero-based grid column, west to east
fields.population: estimated persons in 500m cell, may be fractional
